page: Cache Middleware using Web Standards Cache API. Platforms: Cloudflare Workers (custom domains only, respects Cache-Control header), Deno (1.26+, Deno Deploy). Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {cache} from 'hono/cache'. Headers: Cache-Control (directives), Vary (response header). RFC 10008 QUERY method support with automatic request digest for content-based caching. Separate cache entries for different request bodies. Internal cache key format: /.hono/cache?__hono_cache_key=... for QUERY requests and all methods (affects caches.delete() usage). Default cacheable status code: [200]. Options: cacheName (required, string | function returning string | Promise), wait (optional, boolean, default false, required true for Deno), cacheControl (optional, string, Cache-Control directives), vary (optional, string | string[], merged with existing Vary headers), keyGenerator (optional, (c: Context) => string | Promise<string>, default c.req.url), maxQueryBodySize (optional, number bytes, default 65536 = 64 KiB), cacheableStatusCodes (optional, number[], default [200]), onCacheNotAvailable (optional, callback or false, default logs reason). QUERY requests > 64 KiB bypass cache. Web Crypto required for QUERY caching. Questions: How to add caching? Which platforms support caching? How does QUERY method work? sections.manifest: Import statements for Cache middleware. import {Hono} from 'hono' for the main framework class. import {cache} from 'hono/cache' for the middleware function. Questions: What to import? Where is cache located?

Cache middleware usage for different platforms. Cloudflare Workers: app.get('*', cache({cacheName: 'my-app', cacheControl: 'max-age=3600'})). Deno: same usage but with wait: true required. cacheName (required): identifies cache store, allows multiple caches. cacheControl (optional): Cache-Control header directives per MDN docs. Respects Cache-Control on Cloudflare, Deno doesn't (requires custom invalidation). Questions: How to enable caching? How to set cache duration? Do platforms differ? When is wait needed? What's cacheName for?

Cache middleware QUERY request support per RFC 10008. Caches QUERY method responses. Cache key includes digest of request content and representation metadata. Different request bodies cached separately. QUERY requests with body > maxQueryBodySize (64 KiB default) bypass cache. Internal key format /.hono/cache?__hono_cache_key=... applies to all methods. Important: direct caches.delete() calls must account for internal key, not original request URL. Implication: affects cache purging strategies. Questions: What is QUERY method? How are different bodies cached? What's the body size limit? Why use internal key format? How to manually purge QUERY cache? Can I use standard Cache API?

Cache middleware options specification. Required: cacheName (string | (c: Context) => string | Promise<string>, identifies cache store). Optional: wait (boolean, default false, if true waits for cache.put promise before continuing, required for Deno), cacheControl (string, Cache-Control directives per MDN, not added if omitted), vary (string | string[], sets Vary header, merged with existing, error if set to '*'), keyGenerator ((c: Context) => string | Promise<string>, default c.req.url, generates cache keys based on request/context), maxQueryBodySize (number bytes, default 65536 = 64 KiB, QUERY bodies larger bypass cache), cacheableStatusCodes (number[], default [200], status codes to cache, example [200, 404, 412]), onCacheNotAvailable ((reason: string) => void | Promise<void> | false, callback when Cache API unavailable or Web Crypto missing, default logs, can suppress with false).
